1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d5 4.Bb5 dxe4 5.N.strategy: Backs up the bishop on b5, which Black's queen attacks, and keeps the knight on c6 pinned to the king. White has won back the pawn it gave up, and Black must now untangle the pinned knight while White's pieces are active.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.c3 d5 4.Bb5 dxe4 5.N.name: Ponziani Opening: Spanish Variation, Harrwitz Attack, Nikitin Gambit
